en.flavor: A polearm with an axe blade mounted on top that can deal quite a lot of damage. It's favored by the Millelith officers.

refinements.1: Normal Attacks deal an additional <r>160%</r> ATK as DMG. Can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.2: Normal Attacks deal an additional <r>200%</r> ATK as DMG. This effect can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.3: Normal Attacks deal an additional <r>240%</r> ATK as DMG. This effect can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.4: Normal Attacks deal an additional <r>280%</r> ATK as DMG. This effect can only occur once every 10s.
refinements.5: Normal Attacks deal an additional <r>320%</r> ATK as DMG. This effect can only occur once every 10s.

fr.flavor: Une hampe à l'extrémité de laquelle se trouve un fer de hache. Cette arme puissante est l'une des favorites des officiers des Millelithes.
